cohort: The study included Italian and immigrant pregnant women who underwent an oral glucose tolerance test in three hospitals in Tuscany Region, Central Italy.
finding: Immigrant women showed lower adherence to the prudent diet and a broader use of unhealthy food preparation compared to Italian women, although both groups had similar primary maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: No statistical differences in caesarean section rates were observed between GDM and normal glucose tolerance (NGT) cohorts.
cross-section timing: at the time of GDM screening during pregnancy
